title: Eilenberg inequality (Simon 2.1.9)
statement: Let X be a σ-compact metric space, m ≥ 1 natural, k > 0 real, A ⊆ X 𝓗^{m+k}-null-measurable with 𝓗^{m+k}(A) < ∞ (Simon-normalized Hausdorff measures 𝓗^s = (ω_s/2^s)μH[s]) and f : X → ℝᵐ K-Lipschitz on A. Then y ↦ 𝓗^k(A ∩ f⁻¹{y}) is Lebesgue-a.e.-measurable on ℝᵐ and ∫_{ℝᵐ} 𝓗^k(A ∩ f⁻¹{y}) dLᵐ(y) ≤ (ω_m ω_k/ω_{m+k}) K^m 𝓗^{m+k}(A).
